CURRICULUM VITAE / AN ALTERNATE PRESENT№ 1843

Programmer & analyst

I turn complex briefs into precise steps. I document things nobody has built yet. I am looking for a team that considers curiosity a qualification.

What I bring to the team

  • Algorithmic thinking and the ability to break problems into steps.
  • Technical documentation worth reading.
  • Connecting mathematics, creativity and practical questions.
  • Patience with hardware. Historically proven.

Experience translated into the present FICTION

1843 → TODAY

Algorithm Designer · imaginary Analytical Engine team

I designed a procedure, documented its assumptions and explained its possibilities. Today I would add tests and insist on understandable code reviews.

SIDE PROJECT · FICTION

TeaScript · Chief Kettle Architect

A prototype language whose build pipeline ends in a cup of tea. Outcome: a hydrated team and documentation scented with bergamot.

How I work

First I understand the problem. Then I design a procedure, check the assumptions and only then open the editor. I consider “it works on my machine” the start of a discussion.

Historical basis FACT

  • 1843: translation of Menabrea's text and Notes A - G on the Analytical Engine.
  • Note G contains a procedure for Bernoulli numbers.
  • 1840 - 1841: mathematical correspondence with Augustus De Morgan.
